The '''Demnadi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demnadi]].<ref name="HR" />
